name: Evil
overview: Scripture reveals that evil is fundamentally opposed to God's nature, as He takes no pleasure in wickedness and will not allow evil to dwell with Him (Psalms 5:4). Believers are called to fear the Lord by hating evil and turning away from it, actively pursuing goodness and peace (Proverbs 8:13; Psalms 34:14). Even when others intend evil, God can use those intentions for good, demonstrating His sovereign control over all circumstances (Genesis 50:20). In the face of evil, the faithful find comfort in God's presence and guidance, enabling them to walk without fear through the darkest trials (Psalms 23:4).
